intersection.headline: Sports Direct and Nike launch first brand-exclusive Christmas ad with Haaland, Williamson, Asher-Smith and Pollock
intersection.summary: 'Unwrap Potential' was created by Chaos x Magic and directed by Tyrus Hill. It stars Erling Haaland, England captain Leah Williamson, sprinter Dina Asher-Smith, rugby's Henry Pollock and rapper Aitch as gift advisers under an 'Athlete Intelligence' concept. It is Sports Direct's first brand-exclusive Christmas ad with Nike and runs across TV, social, OOH and 900+ stores, with talent-led gift guides.

intersection.headline: AC Milan reportedly set for record €500m, 10-year Adidas kit deal from 2028-29
intersection.summary: Italian reports, including La Gazzetta dello Sport, say Milan will reunite with Adidas from 2028-29. The reported value is €50m a year, which would be the richest kit deal in Italian football. It would replace Puma, whose deal runs to 2027-28. Figures vary: another report puts it nearer €30m a year, and no official announcement is expected until late 2027 or early 2028.

sports.headline: WNBA Finals set viewership and attendance records after Valkyries' first title
sports.summary: The Golden State Valkyries' Game 7 win over the Atlanta Dream drew 3.3 million viewers, the most-watched WNBA postseason game ever. The seven-game series averaged 1.88 million viewers, the most-watched Finals since 1999. All seven games sold out, and the league also posted its most-watched postseason since 1997. Some outlets note that the all-time-record claims carry qualifiers.

sports.headline: Sky Sports lands UK rights to new women's team golf league WTGL
sports.summary: Sky Sports has exclusive UK rights to WTGL, a women's version of the tech-led TGL golf league developed with the LPGA. The first season starts on 8 November. Charley Hull, Lottie Woad and Jeeno Thitikul are among the first confirmed players. Sky also extended its TGL deal by two years.

sports.headline: Liverpool FC owners emerge as potential buyers of Cadillac F1 stake as Mark Walter seeks a sale
sports.summary: Autosport reports that Liverpool's owners are among the potential buyers of part of Mark Walter's majority stake in the Cadillac F1 team. Sportico first reported the sale, at a valuation of about $3bn. Walter has also moved to sell the Lakers and his Chelsea stake. Sportico's original report appeared on 2 November; Autosport adds the new buyer angle.

sports.headline: Adidas reportedly replaces Puma as Serie A's official ball supplier from 2027-28
sports.summary: Multiple Italian reports say Adidas will take over from Puma as Serie A's ball supplier. The deal would also cover the Coppa Italia, Supercoppa and Serie B. It would add Serie A to Adidas's growing set of ball deals in Europe's top leagues, after the Bundesliga this season. This is based on reports, not an official announcement.

sports.headline: College sports bill in peril after Democrats sweep midterms
sports.summary: Front Office Sports reports that the Protect College Sports Act is now unlikely to pass the House, including in the lame-duck period. Sources say Democrats have little incentive to back it. The outcome matters for the NCAA's attempt to get a legal and regulatory framework for college athletics.

fashion.headline: Yeezy returns to the runway with Season 01 show in Los Angeles
fashion.summary: Ye staged Yeezy Season 01 on 4 November at the brand's new Los Angeles flagship. It was the label's first major runway show since 2022. The show was streamed on Kick. Unreleased Ye music was reportedly used in the soundtrack. It follows Yeezy's soft relaunch and a stockist deal with JD Sports.

fashion.headline: Coperni, known for Bella Hadid's spray-painted dress, announces closure
fashion.summary: Founders Arnaud Vaillant and Sébastien Meyer announced the closure of Coperni. The brand had entered receivership in June amid a long dispute with majority shareholder and exclusive distributor Tomorrow. The closure is a significant casualty for a culturally prominent label.

fashion.headline: A-Cold-Wall names Joshua Bullen as first designer in residence
fashion.summary: Owner Four Marketing is moving the label from a founder-led brand to a studio-driven platform that will rotate guest designers. Bullen is a former Kenzo, Givenchy and Stone Island designer. His debut collection is set for AW27 in Paris. This is the brand's first creative leadership change since founder Samuel Ross sold it.

fashion.headline: Veronica Etro returns to fashion with new brand Off the Menu
fashion.summary: In a WWD exclusive, the former Etro creative figure is launching Off the Menu on Thursday. The brand will offer tightly edited collections of pieces conceived almost as collectibles, and is headquartered in a Milan loft.

fashion.headline: Rachel Scott and Ralph Lauren lead winners at 2026 CFDA Fashion Awards
fashion.summary: Rachel Scott of Diotima won American Womenswear Designer of the Year and Ralph Lauren won Menswear. The ceremony was held at the American Museum of Natural History on Monday 2 November. Keke Palmer hosted, and the evening marked the 30th anniversary of the CFDA Scholarship Fund.

fashion.headline: Dolce & Gabbana's 2026 holiday campaign turns glamour into a cinematic hotel fantasy
fashion.summary: The Italian house's holiday campaign was shot by Gordon von Steiner in a crimson hotel setting. It features gold dresses, tuxedos and leopard-print accents.

marketing.headline: John Lewis enlists Kristin Scott Thomas and Sam Fender for 20th Christmas ad
marketing.summary: It is the first time John Lewis has used a famous face to front its Christmas ad. The tagline is 'Don't Give Up on Giving', and the campaign aims to restore gifting confidence, backed by research that over half of customers feel unconfident about gifts. Saatchi & Saatchi created it, and it launched on 3 November with a three-minute hero film.

marketing.headline: SharkNinja's first global holiday campaign unites Beckham, Brady, Hart and Sabalenka
marketing.summary: The in-house campaign builds on the brand's 'Neighbors' series. It used leaked 'CCTV' clips and denial videos from the stars as teasers before the full spot. Digiday frames it as an example of 'entertainment-first' advertising.

marketing.headline: Boots launches Christmas campaign with first Netflix takeover; CMO explains new brand voice
marketing.summary: Boots' 'For Gifts They'll Really Love' campaign, from VML and WPP, runs under its 'Give it Some Boots' platform. It includes the retailer's first 20-second TV edits and its first Netflix takeover. CMO Charlotte Lock explains the media-mix and brand-voice thinking in a Marketing Week interview.

marketing.headline: Very's Christmas ad blends CGI and AI-assisted animation for a new flamingo family
marketing.summary: Very's 'That's the Very Thing' campaign, from agency The Gate and producer M3Labs, expands its animated flamingo cast. It mixes CGI with AI-assisted animation, which makes it a visible example of AI in a major UK retail ad.

marketing.headline: MNTN hires The Trade Desk's long-time marketing chief as CMO
marketing.summary: On its Q3 earnings call, MNTN said Anna Sayer, who led marketing at The Trade Desk for seven years, joined this week as chief marketing officer. The CEO described it as part of wider leadership changes.
